finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back. Twelve reconnect tries failed on 10.0.0.12:6379.

Cache fell to direct store reads. Every store read timed out at 5000ms. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568, past the 500 cap.

```
02:31:44 ERROR [worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)
02:31:52 FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```

Root cause is Redis, not the app. Check that host first.
